# Bundled data provenance

Retrieved: 2026-09-17
Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/allisonhorst/palmerpenguins/main/inst/extdata/penguins.csv
License: CC0, as documented at https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/
Creators: Allison Marie Horst, Alison Presmanes Hill, Kristen B. Gorman.
Original measurements: Kristen Gorman and Palmer Station LTER.
Package citation: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3960218
Research citation: https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0090081
344 rows, eight columns; raw CSV preserved exactly as retrieved.
SHA-256: f204db2c753b0937caac3cb35258562c14f073e4bbc76be24b4c51ce22767a93

The toy.csv fixture was authored for h2oplyr and is covered by its MIT license.

The windows.csv synthetic fixture was authored for h2oplyr 0.3.0 (MIT license).
Its 16 input rows and independent expected windows cover interleaved/missing
multi-column groups, ties and missing observations. Regeneration is available
in the delivery maintainer tools; no external data download is needed.
